short_description: Program management and technical support services for a habitat design-build project at Salton Sea.
project_scope: Professional support for the Salton Sea Species Conservation Habitat (SCH) Design-Build Project at the New River. The scope covers expert technical advice and consultation for construction management, contract administration, inspection, project management, and other CPMS-related engineering and management services. Requested disciplines include civil, structural, electrical, and mechanical engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, groundwater/hydrogeology, water quality testing, environmental engineering/planning/design, biological studies/natural resources, and inspection services.
